source: Just released · MoF E-Invoicing Guidelines v2.1 · 25 Nov 2026
headline: 380 OR 480?
MOF CLARIFIES YOUR

items: **Code 380:** invoices with taxable supplies where UAE VAT applies
**Code 480:** out-of-scope, or entirely VAT-exempt and/or non-VAT supplies
**Outside VAT is not outside e-invoicing:** only Chapter 7 exclusions remove it
**Retention credit notes:** reason code **DL8.61.1.C** may be used
**Reverse charge lines:** report the GTIN where the item uses one

blocks.text: Revenue **AED 50M+**? Go-live is **1 January 2027**. Check your ERP code mapping now.
